firstPlayerRule: The player who has befriended the most unusual animal starts.
clarifications: Turns proceed clockwise from the first player.
The first player starts with one of each resource; later players receive the extra starting resources listed by play order.
internalEvidence: Downloaded the version 2.2 base-game rulebook from the Google Drive link on Bad Comet’s Wondrous Creatures product page. Its SHA-256 matches an independently hosted copy. Rendered page 6: the Play Order note gives the unusual-animal criterion and clockwise turns; the adjacent setup text gives resources by player order. Creature cards, captains and butterfly nets match inventory BGG 400366. SHA-256: e45a47b4cd96d353aedd773dcaba8e6f37263a6b1a4289bca1b86a9e4e015778. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-22. Editorial review 2026-09-24: Rechecked the starting instruction, game identity and edition against the publisher-produced rulebook. Label edit 2026-09-25: removed file/print bookkeeping from the edition label; rule content unchanged.
uncertainty: “Most unusual” is subjective and the booklet gives no tie procedure; excluded from the portable random mix.
